intro: Visa-free entry for 180 days and banking systems that work for Russian citizens. Yerevan is the main hub for IT entrepreneurs and remote workers.
climate: Continental — snowy winters and hot summers. Sharp temperature swings in the mountain regions.
mentality: Friendly and reserved people who value directness. Most of the urban population speaks Russian.
language_note: Armenian is the official language. Russian is effectively the second language in the capital, and many documents are available in Russian.
visa_note: 180 days visa-free. Residence permit via employment, business or family. A sole proprietorship can be registered in a single day, with a 5% tax on turnover.
